name: Drum list
description: A vertical list with an arrow at the centre; the active line is bold and coloured, the others fade by distance.

recipe.build: List in a mask, translateY one row per beat, per-row opacity and blur from distance to centre, arrow fixed at left.

use_when: Steps, a flow (Preview, Select, Download, Enjoy) or capabilities.
avoid: More than 6 rows; do not use for a single idea.
